content: Randomized controlled trials have been conducted to compare intensive hypertension treatment strategies with standard treatment approaches. According to Table 10.6 from the American Diabetes Association (ADA), one such trial is the ADVANCE study. In this trial, the intervention involved the administration of a single-pill combination therapy consisting of perindopril, an angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE) inhibitor, and indapamide, a thiazide-like diuretic.
